description: Read-only Open Food Facts recipes for barcode product lookup, structured search, nutrition summaries, allergen and ingredient inspection, bounded comparison, category samples, and source posture checks.

novel_features.name: Barcode product lookup
novel_features.description: Fetches one Open Food Facts v3 product record and returns compact identity, labels, countries, nutrition, allergen, data-quality, image, and source URL fields.

novel_features.name: Bounded structured search
novel_features.description: Uses the documented v2 structured search endpoint with category, brand, country, label, nutrition-grade, page, and page-size controls.

novel_features.name: Nutrition summary
novel_features.description: Extracts key nutriments, serving basis, Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score, source URL, and data-quality tags for one barcode.

novel_features.name: Ingredient and allergen inspection
novel_features.description: Reports ingredient text, ingredient analysis tags, allergens, traces, additives, and voluntary-data caveats.

novel_features.name: Small product comparison
novel_features.description: Compares two to five barcode records while preserving per-barcode lookup errors and successful product output.

novel_features.name: Source and rate posture
novel_features.description: Reports read-only auth, custom User-Agent configuration, documented rate limits, anti-bulk non-goals, and local configuration.
